name: 哈诺
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:238
who: Hano, a demon-kin man of the white-bone folk, the one who sits at the gate passage of Rain City writing down names, five hundred and forty-one in 661 and looking about twenty-eight or twenty-nine: about 181 cm, tall and thin with a light frame and a back that stays straight after a whole night sitting. Skin white; the knuckles, collarbones and brow bones are white to a faint shine. Pale ash-grey hair grown to the middle of his back and tied with a leather cord. Grey-white eyes that stay open at night. The little finger of his left hand is bent crooked (on the viewer's right when he faces us), set back by himself at eight years old. A small brass bell hangs on a cord round his left wrist (on the viewer's right). No glasses, no jewellery. A quiet, watchful, unhurried air; he remembers everything.
build: 181 cm, tall and thin: a light frame, narrow shoulders, long arms, a very straight back.
palette: rain-city ash grey, bone white, a little small-bell brass, pencil-charcoal black, old paper cream
casual: His gate-passage clothes: a washed-pale grey cloak of Rain City over a plain dark shirt and trousers, soft old boots; the small brass bell on its cord round his left wrist; at his waist two leather pouches, one holding blank notebooks and sticks of charcoal, the other an old worn notebook with rounded corners. He holds a notebook and a stick of charcoal, a quiet, attentive look.
private: In the long-house after the table is put away: the grey cloak hung on a nail, a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, dark trousers and bare feet in soft slippers, the bell still on his wrist. He sits on a low stool turning the pages of the old notebook with its rounded corners, a calm, faraway look.
battle: Sitting out a night at the gate under attack: the grey cloak pulled close and buttoned at the throat, the leather pouches at his belt, soft boots. He crouches low behind a stone with the notebook open on his knee and the charcoal stick held ready; he carries no weapon, a steady, unblinking gaze.
formal: For the day the long table opens: a long clean dark grey wool coat of Rain City, western cut with a stand collar fastened to the throat by black horn buttons, a narrow band of dark thread at the cuffs and the caravan's black stitching along the hem, a plain brass-buckled belt, the old grey cloak folded over one arm, the small brass bell on his wrist. Thin pale name runes show along the hem. He stands upright with the notebook against his chest, a grave, gentle look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the face turned a little aside, the grey-white eyes open and steady. Soft warm lamp light from a gate-passage fire on one side, cool grey dusk on the other. Foreground blur: a crooked-fingered hand holding a stick of charcoal over a notebook, a drifting ember.

name: 朵特
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:294
who: Dot, a human woman, the gatekeeper of the south gate passage of Rain City, forty-eight in 661 and looking it: about 166 cm, medium height, broad-shouldered with big strong hands and a solid, sturdy build. Dark orange hair with grey in it, cut to just below the ears and held back with a plain cloth band. A face reddened by the gate fire, a thin old scar across the bridge of the nose from a spark. Pale blue-green eyes that look at your feet first. Black under all ten fingernails from feeding the fire. No jewellery. A short spear and a round shield hang in the gate passage, a wooden gourd ladle with seventeen tally marks cut into its handle at her belt. A tough, straight, no-nonsense air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a sturdy woman's face of about forty-eight, NOT young: fire-reddened skin, fine lines at the corners of the pale blue-green eyes and across the brow; level dark-orange brows; a thin old scar across the bridge of the nose; a firm, closed mouth.
build: 166 cm, medium height and sturdy: broad shoulders, strong arms, a C-cup, a thick waist and full hips.
palette: dark orange and grey, gate-fire red, oilcloth olive, worn boiled-leather brown, pale blue-green
casual: Her gate-passage clothes: an oilcloth cloak over an old boiled-leather jerkin, a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and sturdy boots; at her belt the willow-wood gourd ladle with its handle cut in tally marks. She holds a short spear in one hand, its shaft re-fitted many times, and leans a round shield with an old iron rim against her leg, a steady, watchful look.
private: By the gate fire at the end of the day: a thick undyed wool dress with the sleeves rolled, a dark apron, felt slippers, the cloth band in her hair. She feeds a stick to the fire with her big hand and holds the gourd ladle in the other, a tired, warm look.
battle: Holding the gate passage: the oilcloth cloak thrown back over a boiled-leather jerkin of the new court's issue, one patch sewn on the left shoulder, an empty waist-tag ring swinging at the belt, leather gloves, sturdy boots. She braces behind the round iron-rimmed shield with the short spear levelled over its edge, feet planted wide, a hard, level gaze.
formal: For the day the long table opens: a clean brown wool coat issued by the new court, patched once on the left shoulder, an open turned collar over a white shirt, the empty ring of a waist tag hung at her belt, the willow gourd ladle polished by use, hair neat under the cloth band. A thin line of old copper thread glows warm at the cuff. She stands square with her big hands folded in front, a grave, proud look.
art: A three-quarter portrait, her chin level, the pale blue-green eyes looking straight at us. Hard warm orange light from the gate fire on one side, cool blue dusk on the other. Foreground blur: a flame and a flying spark, the gourd ladle's tally marks.

name: 瑞嘉·霜径
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:350
who: Regha Frostpath, a wolf-eared beastfolk woman, a messenger on the southern line for the beastfolk messengers' guild, thirty-one in 661 and looking about thirty: about 175 cm, tall, lean and long-legged, all sinew, with thin shoulders. A pair of grey-white wolf ears, the tip of the left ear (on the viewer's left when she faces us) torn once and stitched with three stitches; no human ears. A grey wolf tail with a black tuft at its tip. Silver-grey hair worn long and tied back in a high tail. Ice-blue eyes that catch the light at night. A narrow face with high cheekbones, two sharp canine teeth showing when she grins. No jewellery, no bells. A quick, cheerful, sing-song air; she hums as she runs. The torn, three-stitch-mended ear tip is on her LEFT ear, which is the ear on the viewer's left when she faces us, drawn as a small ragged notch with three plain thread stitches; the other ear (on the viewer's right) is whole and clean. Both ears are plain grey wolf ears with soft white inner fur: no flower shapes, no clips, no ornaments on either ear, in every panel.
build: 175 cm, tall and lean: thin strong shoulders, long legs corded with muscle, a B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: wolf grey and silver, ice blue, guild-coat slate with a salt-white accent, worn leather brown, black tail tip
casual: Her messenger's clothes: the guild's short coat with the guild badge sewn on the left chest, a bell beside a pinch of salt, over a plain shirt and close-fitting trousers; a flat leather letter satchel slung across the body, a dried-meat pouch at her belt, soft boots with a thin plate of iron nailed to each sole. She holds a rolled letter, a bright, eager look.
private: Resting at the guild hall: a loose undyed linen shirt, a sleeveless wool vest, dark trousers and bare feet in soft slippers, her hair loose over her shoulders, the ear stitches visible. She sits cross-legged humming and rubbing her sore ankles, a relaxed, easy look.
battle: Running a message through a war zone: the guild coat buttoned to the throat, the satchel strapped tight across her chest, the iron-soled boots, a leather glove on each hand. She is mid-stride at a flat run, one hand holding the letter satchel, a short knife at her belt that she never draws, a fierce, focused look.
formal: For the day of the long table: the guild's slate short coat, loose and unfitted, brushed clean, the collar folded open over an undyed linen shirt, the guild badge on the left chest (a small bell beside a pinch of salt, the bell faintly lit by a charm), a leather belt with a plain buckle, the satchel set aside; she stands straight with her wolf ears upright and her hands behind her back, a proud, composed look.
art: A dynamic portrait, her head turned over her shoulder with a quick bright grin showing the canine teeth, wolf ears pricked. Cold silver night light from one side, warm road-lantern light on the other. Foreground blur: a rolled letter in her hand and a streak of road dust.

name: 伊坦·铃尾
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:406
who: Ithan Bellbrush, a fox-eared beastfolk man, a long-distance messenger for the beastfolk messengers' guild, forty in 661 and looking about forty: about 176 cm, medium-tall, lean and long-legged, a thin back and shoulders, standing as if about to run. A pair of russet-brown fox ears, the black tips faded to grey (no human ears). A big bushy fox tail with three small brass bells tied tight at its base so that they never ring. Short russet-brown hair, a face with a flush from running and fine lines at the corners of his amber eyes. No glasses. A slow, patient, steady air; he talks in distances and days.
build: 176 cm, medium-tall and lean: a thin back and shoulders, long legs, a narrow, hard frame.
palette: russet brown and amber, guild-coat slate, salt white, worn leather brown, bell brass
casual: The guild's short coat with the guild badge sewn on the left chest, a bell beside a pinch of salt, over a plain shirt and trousers; a flat leather letter satchel with two buckles at its mouth slung across the body, a small salt pouch at his belt, soft-soled long boots whose soles have been replaced twenty times. He holds a sealed letter, a calm, patient look.
private: At the guild hall after a run: a loose undyed linen shirt, a brown wool vest, dark trousers, soft slippers, his boots set by the door. He sits rubbing his calves with a cup of tea beside him, a tired, amused look.
battle: Running a letter through the line: the guild coat buttoned, the satchel strapped across his chest, long boots, leather gloves, a coil of rope at the belt. He is at a steady long-striding run, one arm swinging, a short knife in his belt that he never draws, a focused, level gaze.
formal: For the day of the long table: a dark grey guild short coat, loose and open at the collar, brushed clean over a white shirt, the badge on the left chest polished, a small bell beside a pinch of salt faintly lit by a charm, a leather belt, the satchel set aside, no trim and no waistcoat. He stands straight with his fox ears upright and the faded tips neat, a quiet, dignified look.
art: A portrait from a little to the side, the amber eyes looking down the road as if measuring the distance. Warm low evening light from one side, cool blue shadow on the other. Foreground blur: the three tied bells at the base of his tail and a blur of road dust.

name: 琉妲
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:698
who: Ruda, a demon-kin woman of the blood-feast folk, night-demon bloodline, the apothecary of the westward caravan, a hundred and sixteen in 661 and looking about fifty: about 170 cm, tall and spare, a slight stoop from long nights crouched by the wounded. Short dark-red hair streaked with white. Two small curved horns on her forehead with black tips. Dark red eyes that glow faintly at night. Seven neat thin scars in a row on the inside of her left wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Long fingers, nails cut very short, herb crumbs under them. A bone knife hangs on a leather cord round her neck. A sharp-tongued, steady-handed, secretly soft air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean woman's face of about fifty, NOT young: fine lines at the corners of the dark red eyes and between the brows; level dark-red brows; a thin, firm mouth; two small black-tipped curved horns on the forehead among the short dark-red and white hair.
build: 170 cm, tall and spare: a slight stoop, narrow shoulders, long arms, a B-cup, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: washed grey, dark red and white, bone white, herb-pouch green-brown, black horn tips
casual: Her healer's clothes: a washed-pale grey cloth robe with one cuff torn short for bandages, over plain dark trousers and worn boots; two herb pouches at her belt; the bone knife on its leather cord round her neck. She kneels with a roll of bandage and a small clay jar in her hands, a sharp, concentrating look.
private: By the wagon at night with the wounded asleep: an undyed wool shawl over the grey robe, the sleeves rolled, her hair loose, felt slippers. She grinds herbs in a small stone bowl, the knife at her neck, a tired, softened look.
battle: Running a field dressing-station on a battlefield: the grey robe belted tight, the sleeves bound, a leather apron, both herb pouches at her belt. She crouches over a wounded soldier pressing a bandage into place, the bone knife in her other hand, a fierce, exacting gaze.
formal: For the day the long table opens: a washed dark grey wool robe of the western cut with a high collar fastened to the throat by bone buttons, a plain belt with two herb pouches, the bone knife tucked inside the collar, her short dark-red hair combed back, a thin band of dark red rune thread at the cuffs glowing like embers. She stands upright with her hands folded, a stern, composed look.
art: A close portrait, her dark red eyes catching the light and a faintly scolding look. Warm candle light from one side, cool grey from the other. Foreground blur: a clay jar of salve, dried herbs and a roll of bandage.

name: 德克·暮歇
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:754
who: Derk Duskrest, a tiefling man, the carter at the tail of the westward caravan, eighty-six in 661 and looking about sixty-something: about 186 cm, tall and spare, broad in the shoulders, with a slight stoop from thirty years of wall armour. White skin with faint dark patterned lines like pressed flowers on old leather from the side of the neck to behind the ears. On his forehead two stumps of horn filed flat for thirty years, now grown back a finger's length, the new part darker, like old wood. A long scar down his right forearm from wrist to elbow (on the viewer's left when he faces us). Iron-grey hair cut short, dark amber eyes. No jewellery. A taciturn, dour, dependable air; he never smiles and no cart he has driven has ever overturned.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean old man's face of sixty-something, NOT young: white skin with faint dark patterned lines from the side of the neck to behind the ears; deep lines at the eye corners and mouth; level iron-grey brows over dark amber eyes; a firm, closed mouth; two short horns of dark old-wood colour on the forehead.
build: 186 cm, tall and spare: a slight stoop, broad shoulders, long arms, a lean frame.
palette: washed grey, iron grey, dark old-wood brown, white stone chips, dull wrought-iron black
casual: His carter's clothes: an old wall-issue coat washed pale, an empty ring for a name-tag still on the belt, over a plain shirt and trousers and worn boots; a driver's whip coiled at the small of his back and a cloth bag of chipped white stones at his belt. He carries a long wrought-iron hook with a white ash shaft on one shoulder, a dour, steady look.
private: At the tail of the camp: the old coat off, a collarless undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled showing the scar, a wool vest, bare head, felt slippers. He sits on a wagon step turning a white stone in his fingers, a quiet, gruff look.
battle: Holding the tail of the caravan: the pale-washed wall coat buttoned over old plate pieces, leather gloves, a battered iron cap pushed back off the horn stumps, a bag of chipped white stones at his belt glowing faintly. He braces with the long iron hook held across his body in both hands, feet wide, a hard, level gaze.
formal: For the day of the long table: a pale-washed wall-issue wool coat brushed clean, worn open at the collar, the empty name-tag ring on the belt, a black glove on one hand, a bag of chipped white stones at his belt whose edges glow faintly white, boots wiped. He stands straight with the iron hook set upright beside him, a grave, dignified look.
art: A portrait from slightly below, the horns and the patterned neck sharp in the frame, the dark amber eyes steady. Low warm sunset light from one side, cold blue on the other. Foreground blur: the iron hook's curved tip and a few white stone chips.

name: 索恩薇娅·里德
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:917
who: Thornevia Reed, a former south-line officer from the reed-hut slums, seventy-four in 661 and still looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight because she has almost stopped ageing, labelled a rebel by the crown: about 174 cm, tall and tight-shouldered, standing like a sword planted in a stone stair. Old-copper gold-brown hair cut short with her own knife to just under the ears, the front locks singed paler toward platinum. Pale gold eyes that look first at what you hold in your hands. A thin white scar at the tail of the left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when she faces us), a large fresh burn scar on the back of her right hand. No jewellery, no earrings. A plain straight sword with a hilt wrapped in rough hemp cord hangs at her belt. She smiles less than she used to.
build: 174 cm, tall and strong: firm shoulders and back, a stable core, long legs, a C-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: old copper and platinum, pale gold, worn leather brown, faded army grey-blue, hemp beige
casual: Her south-line officer's coat, the collar insignia torn off by her own hand and the buttons still not meeting: a faded plain officer coat with a high collar open one button, over old patched leather armour with four patches on the shoulder; a worn belt with a plain straight sword whose grip is wrapped in hemp cord, a cloth bag at the back of the belt. One hand rests on the hilt, a firm, weary look. The sword is a plain straight European arming sword with a simple straight cross-guard and a round pommel, its grip wound with rough hemp cord; NO round guard.
private: Late at the kitchen door of a camp: a loose undyed linen shirt with sleeves rolled, a plain dark wool waistcoat, dark trousers, boots, her short hair untidy, the bandaged burn on her right hand, the sword hung on a nail behind her. She holds a half-eaten loaf, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Marching the line: the patched leather armour over the faded coat, steel vambraces, a worn cloak thrown back, riding boots, the cloth bag at her belt. She holds the hemp-wrapped sword drawn point-down in front of her with both hands, a grounded, unmoving stance, a hard level gaze.
formal: Standing before the people of the camp to read the names: a clean faded blue-grey south-line officer coat with the collar tabs torn off by her own hand and the collar left open at the top button, the buttons still not meeting, patched leather armour showing at the shoulder, a folded sheet of names against her chest, the hemp-wrapped sword at her belt, a trace of old-copper glow in the cuff stitching. A grave, steady look.
art: A portrait, her pale gold eyes lifted, the bandaged hand on the hilt. Hard warm orange light from a burning ridge behind on one side, cool grey dawn on the other. Foreground blur: drifting soot and a torn collar badge.

name: 本尼迪·伊利亚
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:971
who: Benedi Illia, a human priest of the white candle, twenty-nine in 661 and looking nearer forty since that night: about 183 cm, tall and thin, his shoulders slumped forward from years of kneeling by the wounded, two calluses on his knees. Short light-gold hair gone white at both temples. Gold eyes that look first at where a person is bleeding, warm hands. A grey robe with a white candle embroidered on the left chest (on the viewer's right when he faces us), two patches at the knees. A brass candlestick engraved with the Illia family name at his belt, blackened with soot, never cleaned. No glasses. A soft-spoken, gentle, tireless air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of a tired man looking nearer forty than twenty-nine: white at both temples among short light-gold hair; warm gold eyes with faint shadows beneath; level light-gold brows; a gentle mouth.
build: 183 cm, tall and thin: shoulders slumped forward, long hands, a lean, slightly stooped frame.
palette: candle-grey and white, light gold and brass, soot black, a little dried-blood brown, parchment cream
casual: His priest's clothes: a plain grey robe closed down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a white candle embroidered on the left chest, the knees patched twice; at his belt a soot-blackened brass candlestick engraved with his family name; a cloth bag with two packets of powder, one for each side of the wall. He holds the candlestick, a gentle, tired look.
private: In the white-candle hall at night: the grey robe off for a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a wool waistcoat, dark trousers, felt slippers, a blanket over his knees. He sits with a cup of tea and the candlestick on a table, a quiet, faraway look.
battle: Kneeling among the wounded on a burning slope: the grey robe belted tight with the sleeves bound, the cloth bag of powder at his hip, leather gloves. He presses a bandage to a soldier's side with one hand and holds the sooty candlestick up like a small lamp in the other; he carries no weapon, a steady, calm gaze.
formal: For the day of the long table: a grey White Candle robe brushed clean, open at the neck, with a white candle embroidered on the left chest in fresh thread and a narrow gold line at the cuffs, a rope belt, the soot-blackened candlestick at his belt polished only on its base, a small flame inside it that never goes out. He stands with his hands folded, a grave, kind look.
art: A close portrait, the gold eyes lifted and kind, white temples showing. Warm candle light from one side, cool grey smoke light on the other. Foreground blur: a soot-blackened brass candlestick, a small flame and a roll of bandage.

name: 约伦·无炉
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1027
who: Joren Forgeless, a dwarf woman of no clan, a camp cook who follows the great pot from the reed-hut slums of the golden-kite capital, seventy-three in 661 and, being a dwarf, looking like a human woman in her early twenties: about 138 cm, short, stout and broad-shouldered, with thick arms. Two thick ginger-red braids coiled on top of her head so they cannot fall into the pot. A round face and a big nose with a red tip from smoke. Small bright amber eyes. Thick red hands with ring on ring of burn scars on the fingers. No beard. A blunt, gruff air; the pot is taller than her and the soup is hotter than her temper.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf woman's round, ruddy face of about twenty, NOT a child's and with no beard: small bright amber eyes; short strong ginger brows; a big round nose with a red tip; a firm, blunt mouth.
build: 138 cm, short, stout and strong: broad shoulders, a full bust, a thick waist and full hips.
palette: ginger red and amber, oilcloth olive, iron black, smoke grey, river-reed beige
casual: Her camp cook's clothes: an oilcloth apron with a few burned holes patched on its front, over a dark brown wool dress with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, sturdy boots; at her belt a long-handled iron ladle, a bag of salt and a kitchen knife; slung on her back the great iron pot with a line of small letters cut into its rim, the bottom patched three times. She raps the ladle on the pot, a gruff, impatient look.
private: At the cooking fire after the last bowl: the apron off, a plain undyed wool dress with sleeves rolled, felt slippers, the braids loosened a little. She sits on an upturned bucket with her burned hands wrapped round a bowl of her own soup, a tired, content look.
battle: Feeding a camp while the line is under attack: a thick wool coat under the oilcloth apron, a wool scarf, the great pot on her back, the long-handled iron ladle gripped in one fist like a club; she is not a fighter.
formal: For the day of the long table: a clean dark brown wool dress with a folded white collar, a leather shoulder strap holding a small salt pouch, the apron left off, the braids neatly coiled, the iron ladle scoured bright and hung at her belt, its handle cut with tally marks that glow faintly orange. She stands square with her chin up, hands folded over her belt, a proud, stubborn look.
art: A warm close portrait, the amber eyes narrowed in a scolding grin, the nose red from smoke. Orange cooking-fire light from one side, cool blue dusk on the other. Foreground blur: steam from the great pot and a ladle held up.

name: 桑娜
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1083
who: Sanna, a thirteen-year-old half-human, half-deep-tide demon-kin girl, the rope-maker's daughter of the long-house on the craftsmen's street of Rain City: about 151 cm, thin and tall for her age, with long fingers callused at the tips from twisting rope. Black hair with a hint of blue that dries slowly and always looks just washed, worn loose to the shoulders. Two thin gill slits behind her ears, closed and hidden under her hair. Grey-green eyes that look at your face first. A short length of burnt rope tied round her left wrist (on the viewer's right when she faces us), joined with her own knot. A hard, stubborn, serious air; she can tell whose child you are by your face. She is only thirteen: all of her hair is black with a blue sheen, with no white streak or pale lock anywhere.
palette: faded blue-black, soot grey, hemp beige, grey-green, a little scorched rope brown
casual: A grey wool coat from the white-candle hall, buttoned up high, its sleeves too long and rolled three times, over a plain dark dress and sturdy boots; the burnt rope round her wrist; a coil of thin cord at her belt. She twists a length of cord between her fingers, a serious, watchful look.
private: In the long-house of an evening: a plain high-necked undyed linen dress with long sleeves and a grey wool shawl, a woollen cap pulled down, felt slippers. She sits cross-legged twisting a length of cord, a quiet, thoughtful look.
battle_pose: 3) the lost-child search outfit: the grey coat buttoned up to her chin with the sleeves rolled, a wool cap pulled down over her ears, sturdy boots, a coil of rope over one shoulder; she carries no weapon and stands braced, holding the rope end tight in both hands and looking sharply ahead.
battle: Out in the lanes after a lost child: the grey coat buttoned to the chin with the sleeves rolled, a wool cap pulled down, sturdy boots, a coil of rope over one shoulder; she carries no weapon.
formal: For the day of the long table: a clean dark blue wool dress with a white collar and sleeves of the right length, her black-blue hair combed and tied back with a cord, the burnt rope at her wrist. She stands straight with her hands folded in front, a solemn look.
art: A close portrait of her face and shoulders only, the grey-green eyes open and serious. Warm lamp light from one side, cool blue dusk on the other. Foreground blur: a half-twisted rope between her small hands.

name: 妮珂·铃尾
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1139
who: Niko Bellbrush, a sixteen-year-old fox-eared beastfolk girl, a short-run messenger for the beastfolk messengers' guild and the daughter of Ithan Bellbrush: about 154 cm, small and slight, long-legged, light on her feet. A pair of russet-brown fox ears with a black tip, just like her father's (no human ears). A big fox tail with three old brass bells tied at its base, too loosely, so they jingle when she runs. Russet-brown hair worn tied back in a short tail. Amber eyes that catch the light at night. No jewellery besides the bells. An eager, bright, determined air; she hears the bells before she sees herself.
palette: russet brown and amber, guild-coat slate, salt white, old bell brass, worn leather brown
casual: The guild's short coat with the guild badge sewn on the left chest, a bell beside a pinch of salt, cut down from her father's old one, over a plain shirt and trousers; a flat leather letter satchel with two buckles slung across the body, a small salt pouch at her belt, soft-soled boots. She holds a sealed letter, an eager look.
private: At the guild hall in the evening: a loose undyed linen shirt, a brown wool vest, long dark trousers, soft slippers, her hair loosened from its tail. She sits with her feet tucked up and the three bells in her lap, a thoughtful, bright look.
battle: Running a short message along the road: the guild coat buttoned to the throat, the satchel strapped across her chest, soft boots, gloves. She is mid-stride at a flat run, one hand on the satchel strap, a determined, focused look.
formal: For the day of the long table: a clean slate guild short coat cut down from her father's, loose at the shoulders and worn open at the collar over a white shirt, the guild badge, a small bell beside a pinch of salt, polished on the left chest and lit by a faint charm, long dark trousers, her fox ears upright. She stands straight holding a sealed letter before her in both hands, a proud, earnest look.
art: A bright portrait to the chest, the amber eyes wide open and serious, the fox ears pricked. Warm lantern light from one side, cool blue road dusk on the other. Foreground blur: a rolled letter and a blur of road dust.

name: 京特
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:1316
who: Gunter, a human man, the captain of the palace guard at the bottom step of the crown terrace of the golden-kite city, fifty-eight in 668 and looking early fifties: about 183 cm, tall and lean, broad-shouldered, his back as straight as a spear. Grey-white hair cropped close to the scalp, a long face with a very clean-shaven chin and fine wind-lines on both cheeks. Steel-blue eyes that look at your feet first. His heels turn outward when he stands, which he does not know. No jewellery. A stiff, exact, upright air; he looks straighter than the sword beside him.
